name: Wei Wuxian
summary: An eccentric and brilliant cultivator known for his unconventional thinking, quick wit, and mastery over resentful energy.

name: Lan Wangji
summary: A remarkably righteous and austere cultivator renowned for his strict adherence to rules, exceptional musical talent, and icy demeanor.

name: Mo Xuanyu
summary: A troubled and eccentric former disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan residing within the secluded Mo estate.

name: Mo Ziyuan
summary: Mo Xuanyu's arrogant cousin who abuses him and steals his magical talismans.

name: Jiang Cheng
summary: The fiery and ambitious leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan who holds a fierce pride in his sect and a notoriously short temper.

name: Lan Sizhui
summary: A polite, sensible, and level-headed junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan who frequently helps manage chaotic peer situations.

name: Jiang Yanli
summary: A remarkably gentle, nurturing, and compassionate elder sister who is exceptionally skilled at making comforting lotus pork rib soup.

name: Lan Xichen
summary: The gentle and empathetic leader of the Gusu Lan Clan, widely praised for his warmth, wisdom, and close bond with his younger brother.

name: Lan Qiren
summary: A notoriously strict and pedantic elder and teacher of the Gusu Lan Clan who prides himself on producing exemplary disciples.

name: Lan Jingyi
summary: A spirited and outspoken junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan known for his quick tongue and frequent frustration with strict sect rules.

name: Jin Ling
summary: A proud and easily provoked young master of the Lanling Jin Clan who carries a strong sense of pride alongside a sensitive heart.

name: Jin Guangyao
summary: A remarkably smooth, diplomatic, and ambitious leading figure known for his permanent smile and ability to navigate complex political alliances.

name: Jin Zixuan
summary: The arrogant yet genuinely principled heir of the Lanling Jin Clan who possesses high standards and a clumsy awkwardness regarding romance.

name: Nie Huaisang
summary: The seemingly inept leader of the Qinghe Nie Clan who prefers painting fans and avoiding cultivation duties over administrative matters.

name: Nie Mingjue
summary: The fierce, righteous, and short-tempered sect leader of the Qinghe Nie Clan who wields a heavy saber with terrifying might.

name: Wen Ning
summary: A timid and soft-spoken archer belonging to the Qishan Wen Clan who suffers from severe shyness and an inferiority complex.

name: Wen Qing
summary: A fiercely protective medical genius of the Qishan Wen Clan renowned for her unmatched healing skills and sharp tongue.

name: Wen Ruohan
summary: The incredibly powerful, ambitious, and dictatorial leader of the Qishan Wen Clan who commands the most dominant cultivation sect in the land.

name: Xiao Xingchen
summary: A righteous and morally unblemished Daoist priest who leaves the mountain realm to help common folk and rid the world of evil.

name: Song Lan
summary: A proud and righteous Daoist priest dedicated to upholding justice alongside his lifelong friend Xiao Xingchen.

name: Xue Yang
summary: A dangerous and playful rogue cultivator with a penchant for cruelty and a notorious obsession with sweet pastries.

name: Jin Guangshan
summary: The ambitious and self-serving former leader of the Lanling Jin Clan who constantly seeks to elevate his clan's political power. Mo Xuanyu's biological father

name: Wen Chao
summary: The arrogant and cruel second son of Wen Ruohan who takes pleasure in humiliating and tormenting other clans.

name: Su She
summary: The petty and insecure leader of the Moling Su Clan, formerly a disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan who deeply envies Lan Wangji.

name: Madam Mo
summary: The domineering and bitter matriarch of the Mo estate.

name: A-Tong
summary: A young servant boy employed in the Mo family household.

name: A-Ding
summary: A young maidservant serving in the Mo family household.

name: Master Mo
summary: The master of the Mo estate and Madam Mo's husband.

name: A-Yan
summary: A young woman from Buddha's Foot Town who inexplicably lost her sanity and wanders the streets dancing with a vacant smile.

name: Blacksmith Zheng
summary: A blacksmith residing in Buddha's Foot Town and the father of A-Yan.

name: Jiang Fengmian
summary: The gentle, patient, and fair-minded Sect Leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan who takes in the orphaned Wei Wuxian as a ward.

name: Yu Ziyuan
summary: The formidable, sharp-tongued, and fiercely proud matriarch of the Yunmeng Jiang Clan who wields the powerful lightning whip Zidian.

name: Madam Jin
summary: The proud and strong-willed matriarch of the Lanling Jin Clan, who is a close friend of Madam Yu and the protective mother of Jin Zixuan.

name: Yin Tiger Tally
sect_or_affiliation: Created and wielded by Wei Wuxian
summary: A powerful and perilous dark artifact forged by Wei Wuxian from iron found inside the Xuanwu of Slaughter, capable of commanding vast armies of fierce corpses.
affiliation: Created and wielded by Wei Wuxian

name: Spirit-Locking Pouch
summary: A specialized spiritual pouch used by cultivators to safely trap, store, and preserve spirits, soul fragments, or resentful energy.

name: Bichen
summary: A top-grade spiritual sword with a refined, transparent-looking blade that radiates an icy-blue light, wielded by Lan Wangji.

name: Gusu Lan Sect
summary: A prominent righteous cultivation sect based in the Cloud Recesses of Gusu, widely respected for its strict discipline, musical spiritual techniques, and thousands of clan rules.

name: Qinghe Nie Sect
summary: The prominent cultivation clan based in Qinghe, known for its fortress-like headquarters called the Unclean Realm and its unique tradition of wielding sabers instead of swords.

name: Yunmeng Jiang Sect
summary: One of the five great cultivation sects in the cultivation world, headquartered at the scenic Lotus Pier and recognized for its free-spirited doctrines and adeptness in water-based martial arts.

name: Deity-Binding Net
summary: An expensive, high-grade spiritual tool woven from gold thread that is used by cultivators to capture spiritual beasts, deities, and malevolent prey.

name: Lanling Jin Sect
summary: One of the prominent Five Great Cultivation Sects, renowned for its vast wealth, opulent lifestyle, and its grand residence at Koi Tower.

name: Qiankun Pouch
summary: A magical, pocket-sized storage pouch utilized by cultivators that employs spatial manipulation to hold large quantities of items, spiritual tools, or captured entities far exceeding its physical dimensions.

name: Spirit-Attraction Flag
pinyin_or_chinese: 招魂幡 (Zhāohún fān) / 招阴旗 (Zhāoyīn qí)
aliases: 招魂幡 (Zhāohún fān) / 招阴旗 (Zhāoyīn qí)
summary: A specialized Daoist paper talisman and flag created by Wei Wuxian that emits spiritual energy attractive to ghosts, fierce corpses, and wandering spirits, drawing them away from ordinary humans and toward the flag's bearer.

name: Dancing Goddess
summary: A ten-foot-tall stone statue sculpted by nature on Dafan Mountain

name: Evil-Pointing Compass
summary: A revolutionary magical compass invented by Wei Wuxian that detects the presence and direction of malevolent energy, fierce corpses, and spirits to aid cultivators during night hunts.

name: Zidian
summary: A powerful, ring-shaped spiritual weapon belonging to Jiang Cheng that can transform into a whip crackling with purple electricity.

name: Koi Tower
summary: The grand and opulent headquarters of the Lanling Jin Sect located in Lanling, famous for its towering golden architecture, massive staircases, and decorations featuring the Sparks Amidst Snow peony motif.

name: Sunshot Campaign
aliases: The Campaign to Shoot down the Sun
summary: A grand military coalition launched by the major cultivation sects to rebel against the tyrannical oppression and aggressive expansion of the Qishan Wen Sect.

name: Lotus Pier
summary: The picturesque, sprawling lakeside residence and headquarters of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, famous for its abundant lotus lakes and its open, free-spirited atmosphere.

name: The Cloud Recesses
pinyin_or_chinese: 云深不知处 (Yún Shēn Bù Zhī Chù)
aliases: 云深不知处 (Yún Shēn Bù Zhī Chù)
summary: The elegant, mountain-shrouded headquarters of the Gusu Lan Sect, renowned for its serene atmosphere, thousands of strict rules, and mist-covered peaks.

name: Wall of Discipline
summary: A massive stone cliffside situated at the entrance of the Cloud Recesses, carved with thousands of strict rules and regulations that govern the daily conduct of the Gusu Lan Sect's disciples and visitors.

name: Silence Spell
summary: A signature spell utilized by the Gusu Lan Sect that temporarily seals a target's ability to speak.

name: Jingshi
summary: The secluded private residence and study of Lan Wangji located within the Cloud Recesses.

name: Emperor's Smile
summary: A famous, fragrant liquor brewed in Caiyi Town of Gusu, noted for its exceptional flavor and favored by Wei Wuxian.

name: Mo Village
summary: A mortal settlement and the estate of the wealthy Mo family, where the former Lanling Jin disciple Mo Xuanyu resides.

name: Passage Jade Token
summary: A specialized jade talisman carried by members and authorized guests of the Gusu Lan Sect to safely navigate and bypass the protective barrier surrounding the Cloud Recesses.

name: Wen Mao
summary: The founding ancestor of the Qishan Wen Sect who first elevated the clan above the sect to usher in the age of hereditary houses.

name: Qishan Wen Clan
summary: The largest and most powerful of the five great cultivation sects, famous for using the sun as its motif and holding immense political and military dominance over the cultivation world.

name: Golden Core
summary: An internal sphere of spiritual energy formed within a cultivator's dantian that serves as the foundation for storing and channeling spiritual power.

name: Yunmeng
summary: A scenic, water-locked region characterized by its vast lakes and lotus ponds, serving as the ancestral home and seat of power for the prominent Yunmeng Jiang Sect.

name: Qinghe Nie Clan
summary: One of the major cultivation sects in the Jianghu, known for residing in Qinghe and specializing in saber techniques rather than traditional swords.

name: Yashi
summary: The quiet and refined reception study located within the Cloud Recesses, primarily used by the Gusu Lan Sect Leader and grandmasters for hosting private discussions and receiving important guests.

name: Jiangnan Region
sect_or_affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect / Yunmeng Jiang Sect
summary: A scenic geographical and cultural region south of the Yangtze River, known for its lush waterways, lotus lakes, and mild climate, which serves as the setting for sects like Gusu Lan and Yunmeng Jiang.
affiliation: Gusu Lan Sect / Yunmeng Jiang Sect

name: Suibian
summary: The personal spiritual sword of Wei Wuxian, crafted and gifted to him by Jiang Fengmian, the leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect.

name: Sandu
summary: The signature spiritual sword of Jiang Cheng, the sect leader of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, named after the three Buddhist poisons of greed, anger, and delusion.

name: Water Abyss
summary: A terrifying aquatic phenomenon born from decades of accumulated resentment and drowned souls, possessing a near-indestructible nature.

name: Lake Biling
summary: A large body of water located near Caiyi Town that becomes the site of a hazardous night hunt.

name: Caiyi Town
summary: A lively water town situated near the mountain base of Cloud Recesses, famous for its canals, loquats, and Emperor's Smile liquor.

name: Nightless Sky
aliases: Immortal Capital of the Nightless City
summary: The colossal, fortress-like ancestral domain and capital city of the Qishan Wen Sect.

name: Library Pavilion
summary: A tranquil pavilion situated within the Cloud Recesses that houses the Gusu Lan Sect's vast repository of ancient scrolls, historical records, and cultivation texts.

name: Lan An
summary: The historical founder of the Gusu Lan Sect who was originally a temple monk before returning to secular life, choosing the surname Lan, and establishing the cultivation clan in Gusu after finding his fated partner.

name: Meishan Yu Sect
summary: A prominent cultivation clan based in Meishan, recognized as the maternal ancestral sect of Yu Ziyuan, Jiang Cheng, and Jiang Yanli.

name: Little Apple
summary: A stubborn, temperamental donkey with a discriminating palate for fresh apples that serves as Wei Wuxian's mount.

name: Xinglu Ridge
summary: A hazardous mountainous region known for being shrouded in fierce ghosts and resentful energy.

name: Malignant Curse Mark
summary: A dark, spreading brand inflicted upon a cultivator's body by malevolent spirits or curses that steadily expands across the skin over time.

name: Fairy
summary: A spirited spiritual dog of the spirit hound breed gifted to Jin Ling by Jin Guangshan.

name: Yiling
summary: A remote and impoverished town located under the jurisdiction of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect, most notably housing the infamous Burial Mounds.

name: Yueyang Chang Sect
summary: A minor cultivation sect based in the Yueyang region, residing at the Chang Manor.

name: Chang Ping
summary: The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect, a cultivation clan based in the Yueyang region.

name: Wei Changze
summary: The father of Wei Wuxian, who formerly served as a subordinate and close companion to Sect Leader Jiang Fengmian of the Yunmeng Jiang Sect before departing to travel with the rogue cultivator Cangse Sanren.

name: Cangse Sanren
summary: A highly talented rogue cultivator and former disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, renowned for her lively personality, exceptional spiritual power, and marriage to Wei Changze.

name: Baoshan Sanren
summary: A legendary, immortal cultivator who resides on a secluded celestial mountain and takes in disciples on the strict condition that once they leave her sanctuary to enter the mortal world, they can never return.

name: Yanling Daoren
summary: The first disciple of the immortal Baoshan Sanren, who chose to descend from his teacher's secluded mountain to enter the mortal world as a rogue cultivator.

name: Shuanghua
summary: The prestigious spiritual sword of the wandering cultivator Xiao Xingchen, distinguished by its silver blade carved with frost-like patterns and its unique ability to detect and point toward corpse energy.

name: Chenqing
summary: A famous jet-black Chinese flute (dizi) utilized by Wei Wuxian to command fierce corpses and channel demonic cultivation.

name: Wen Zhuliu
summary: A powerful and loyal cultivator serving the Qishan Wen Sect, feared throughout the cultivation world for his unique ability to dissolve a cultivator's golden core.

name: Night-hunting
summary: The standard practice of cultivators traveling across the land to exorcise malevolent spirits, ghosts, demons, and monsters to protect the populace and gain practical experience.

name: Jiangzai
summary: A sharp spiritual sword radiating a dark and malevolent aura, wielded as the primary weapon of Xue Yang.

name: Clarity Bell
summary: A silver bell adorned with the nine-petaled lotus motif worn at the waist by Yunmeng Jiang Clan members to steady the mind and dispel malevolent illusions.

name: A-Qing
summary: A cheeky and street-smart young girl who pretends to be blind in order to survive by begging and scamming travelers.

name: Chang Ci'an
summary: The leader of the Yueyang Chang Sect who is established in the narrative through his early interactions with Xue Yang during the latter's youth.

name: Fuxue
summary: The elegant spiritual sword wielded by the wandering cultivator Song Lan, representing his refined skill and dedication to justice.

name: Lingchi
summary: usually translated "slow slicing" or (incorrectly) "death by a thousand cuts", is a form of torture and execution where a knife is used to methodically remove portions of the body over an extended period of time, eventually resulting in death.

name: Burial Mounds
summary: A notorious ancient battleground and mass grave in Yiling heavily saturated with dark resentful energy and unburied corpses, universally regarded by cultivation sects as a perilous forbidden zone.

name: Ouyang Zizhen
summary: A young cultivator belonging to the Baling Ouyang Clan who frequently travels and participates in various night-hunts alongside his generational peers.

name: Tortoise of Slaughter
summary: An ancient, deformed beast resembling a gargantuan carnivorous tortoise with a serpent head that dwells in a subterranean lake beneath Mount Muxi.

name: Liebing
summary: A spiritual white jade xiao, or vertical flute, carried and played by Lan Xichen to channel musical spiritual energy.

name: Yi City
summary: A remote, perpetually fog-shrouded town famously characterized by its prominent coffin-making trade and funerary shops.

name: Discussion Conference
summary: Grand recurring gatherings hosted by the prominent cultivation sects to discuss spiritual philosophy, showcase spiritual skills, and negotiate political matters.

name: Moling Su Sect
summary: A cultivation sect based in Moling founded by Su She, a former disciple of the Gusu Lan Sect, which mimics the musical cultivation techniques and practices of the Lan Clan.

name: Qin Su
summary: The gentle and supportive wife of Jin Guangyao, who was raised as the daughter of the Laoling Qin Sect's leader.

name: Jin Chan
summary: A junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan who participates in the Discussion Conference and the third-party hunts.

name: Sizhui
summary: A polite, sensible, and well-behaved young junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan who frequently helps keep his peers in line.

name: Jingyi
summary: A lively, outspoken, and easily flustered junior disciple of the Gusu Lan Clan known for his quick wit and humorous complaints.

name: Nie Mingjiao
summary: The formidable and fierce leader of the Qinghe Nie Clan who possesses an unwavering sense of justice and a fierce intolerance for evil.

name: Yunping City
summary: A bustling city associated with the Lanling Jin Sect where the Guanyin Temple is located.

name: Wen Xu
summary: The eldest son of Sect Leader Wen Ruohan and a prominent, authoritative cultivator within the Qishan Wen Sect.

name: Baxia
summary: The signature saber of Sect Leader Nie Mingjue, renowned for its immense weight, hostile spirit, and compatibility with the aggressive saber techniques of the Qinghe Nie Sect.

name: Unclean Realm
summary: The fortress-like ancestral home and headquarters of the Qinghe Nie Sect, characterized by its austere, stone-walled architecture built into rugged mountain cliffs.

name: The Watchtowers
summary: A network of surveillance and defense stations proposed by Jin Guangyao and built across various regions to monitor spiritual disturbances and allow commoners to easily request aid from cultivators.

name: Hensheng
summary: An extremely flexible soft sword wielded by Jin Guangyao, which is thin enough to be worn concealed around the waist.

name: Suihua
summary: A prestigious spiritual sword of the Lanling Jin Sect, wielded by Jin Zixuan and subsequently inherited by his son Jin Ling.
